headline.en: Fortress Co-CEO Warns Private Credit On AI Deals: 'You're Not Getting Paid For That Upside'
headline.zh: Fortress联席首席执行官就AI交易警告私人信贷：“你没有获得上行回报”

summary.en: Fortress Co-CEO warned private credit lenders against AI-related deals, saying lenders are not being paid for the upside. The warning concerned underwriting in AI deals.
summary.zh: Fortress联席首席执行官就AI相关交易向私人信贷贷款机构发出警告，称贷款方未获得上行回报。该警告针对AI交易的承销。
